digest.component_or_area: Cross-repository quality assessment and governance audit
propositions: 87 source modules exceed the 500-LOC target documented in architecture.md, with llm/runner.py, _config_schema.py, _commands/init.py, _ref_lock.py, and signing.py each at or above 798 LOC; compute() and import_tickets() are representative high-complexity orchestration hotspots requiring modular refactoring

Global mypy passes all source but --disallow-untyped-defs diagnostic found 687 errors; only rebar.graph and rebar.grounding enforce untyped-def rules, indicating incomplete type precision across the codebase

Python 3.11 xdist worker dies non-deterministically in test_opcert_service_app.py::test_matching_guard_is_accepted after ~11.4k passing tests with 'node down: Not properly terminated' error, observed in 4+ Gerrit Verified runs and scheduled mirrors but passing unchanged on rerun, indicating CI flakiness rather than patch regression

Documentation teaches --assignee alice as a quickstart example, contradicting config.md requirements for email/accountId and resulting in unassigned Jira records when bare handles are used; also docs/README.md routes incorrectly and references obsolete config.conf paths

Test-environment assumptions cause reproducible failures: tests/interfaces/contracts/test_help_overview_coverage.py:142 fails on Mach-O binaries in editor_assets/node_modules; tests/unit/test_attestation_signing.py:430 fails on shallow promisor Git clones lacking historical objects
Mutation testing evidence is strong but stale (dated June/July 2026) and non-gating; no CI workflow invokes mutmut, reducing confidence in behavioral test quality and survivor rates
